verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page claims its own incident-triggered automation: posting a todo list when a new incident is triggered and routing it to the right responder. Metadata can also feed escalation rules. Escalation policies cover alert ordering, which is adjacent to this story rather than a general workflow engine. missing for 10: documented condition-based workflow builder, automated status/stakeholder updates, scheduled reminders, automatic incident field changes, in-depth workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, a condition-based workflow engine automates the toil — updates, reminders, field changes — triggered by incident events

citations.quote: Post a todo list when a new incident is triggered. Route the incident to the right responder.
Attach business knowledge to all incidents for more granular reporting and escalation rules with catalog and metadata.
